case.summary: Transaction 3553342 ($30.91, in_person, product code W on 2016-12-18) was flagged by the bank's model at risk score 0.55. The cardholder's account shows 991 legitimate transactions across 42 billing regions with median spend $49.05, making this transaction consistent with established patterns. The account does carry prior fraud history (case CC-2370, card_not_present_fraud), and case memory returned 8 structurally similar closed cases all confirmed as fraud, retrieved via shared device profile with account C10149. However, those prior cases involved out_of_region_use and card_not_present patterns, whereas the current transaction is in_person and within the cardholder's normal geographic and channel activity. The assessed fraud probability is 0.18 with no pattern match identified. Because the case rests on a moderate risk score alone and fraud probability falls well below 0.70, blocking without verification would violate policy. I conclude this transaction is legitimate with low confidence that it represents fraud, and recommend closure without action.
